text:
Alyssa Chen: @channel quick q — I'm juggling a sudden change in dependent care starting next week. Can people-ops advise on temporary shift in core hours and how this might affect my mid-year check-in? Prefer the conversation stay confidential :pray:

Jamal Ortiz: Thanks for flagging Alyssa. Happy to support. @Maria (People Ops) mind advising? Alyssa, happy to chat over DM if you'd prefer.

Maria (People Ops): Hi Alyssa :wave: You can request a temporary accommodation for caregiving. Two routes: informal manager agreement (fast) or formal accommodation request (documented, ADA-protected). Both won't automatically penalize you for performance reviews — managers should factor adjusted expectations.

HR Bot: If you need the form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/accom — choose 'dependent care' option.

Alyssa Chen: Thanks. I'd prefer documented temporary change for 6 weeks: shift core to 10:00–16:00, remote Tues/Thu. Will that require paperwork?

Maria (People Ops): Short answer: yes for formal request. We'll need a signed form and start/end dates. Example schedule works. I'll route to accommodation team; decision within 3 business days usually. Quick example template below.

Maria (People Ops): ```
Requested accommodation: Temporary shift to core hours 10:00–16:00 and remote Tues/Thu
Start date: 2026-04-01
End date: 2026-05-14
Impact on duties: Will attend async standups, shift overlap with team 10–16.
Manager: Jamal Ortiz
```

Maria (People Ops): We'll also note intermittent leave options (e.g., FMLA) if eligible. Manager guidance: document agreed checkpoints; adjust goals if necessary. This won't count as a performance infraction — managers should not lower ratings for taking reasonable accommodations.

Jamal Ortiz: I support this. We'll adjust sprint assignments and set a biweekly 30m sync to review load. I'll mark it as confidential and keep notes factual.

Alyssa Chen: Appreciate it. Quick Q — will PTO accrual be affected? And what if I need to extend?

Maria (People Ops): PTO accrual is unaffected. If you need an extension, update the form or request an amendment; we process extensions within 2 business days. For extensions beyond ~90 days we'll discuss other leave/benefits options.

HR Bot: Auto-reply: Form saved (ID: AC-2026-482). You should get an email confirmation. If not, ping @Maria (People Ops). :information_source:

Alyssa Chen: got the confirmation. Thanks everyone :heart:

Noah Patel: quick note for managers — accommodations are a protected process; keep notes minimal and factual. If a role change or long-term performance concern emerges, loop in people-ops and legal early. :eyes:
